content: OWASP ASVS is scoped to web applications; latest official ASVS page identifies version 5.0.0, so old template chapter labels must not be passed off as current numbering. Mobile phase uses MASVS context, especially STORAGE, CODE and PRIVACY. Orrery introduces no authentication/backend/network; primary threats are invalid stored preferences, untrusted IDs in SQL, stale reorder races and accidentally rendering deleted/linked data. Use existing SQLite validated DAO and shared transaction boundaries; do not add new encryption/telemetry posture.
